crying_in_the_walls.title: Crying in the Walls
crying_in_the_walls.description: You hear a child crying inside the walls. Soft, then louder. You search every room — empty. The crying continues. It seems to follow you.

outcomes.text: A radio, left on, looping a child's voice. You smash it.
An actual child, feral but alive. She watches you for hours before speaking.
Nothing. You search for hours. The crying never stops. You barely sleep.
You wake up exhausted, but alive. The crying has stopped.
You don't look back.

the_offer.title: An Offer
the_offer.description: A well-dressed man steps out from behind a car. Clean shave. Clean clothes. A clean smile. 'I represent a community,' he says. 'We have walls. We have food. We have rules. Come with me.'

outcomes.text: He's telling the truth. You spend a week in safety, leave with supplies.
It's a cult. You escape after three days. You smell like incense for weeks.
Cannibals. You barely escape. You learned what the 'rules' were.
He shrugs and walks away. 'Suit yourself.'
His smile flickers. He doesn't shrug.
He drops. You loot the body. A list of names. Your name isn't on it. Yet.

stranger_at_the_door.title: Stranger at the Door
stranger_at_the_door.description: Someone is knocking. Three times. Pause. Three times. They don't sound infected. They might be lying.

outcomes.text: You let them in.
They're alone, scared, helpful. They wait until you're ready.
They lie. Badly. You hear others whispering behind them. They leave.
They scream and bang on the door for an hour. Then silence. In the morning, claw marks.
They give up. You feel something — guilt? relief? You're not sure which.
They die outside. Their corpse attracts attention.

the_dog.title: The Dog
the_dog.description: A golden retriever trots up to you, tail wagging. It's wearing a tactical vest. There is a note pinned to the vest: 'HIS NAME IS BISCUIT. HE IS A GOOD BOY. PLEASE TAKE CARE OF HIM. HE HAS SEEN THINGS.'

outcomes.text: Biscuit licks your face. The world is briefly, briefly okay.

options.text: Take the vest, leave the dog

outcomes.text: Biscuit watches you walk away. You will think about this for the rest of your life.

wandering_trader.title: Wandering Trader
wandering_trader.description: An old man pulls a shopping cart full of junk. 'Trade?' he says. He shows you what he's got: bandages, ammo, a single mysterious can with no label.

options.text: Trade scrap for medical supplies (2 scrap)

outcomes.text: Fair deal.
Peaches. Real peaches.
Cat food. You eat it anyway.
Empty. You should have shaken it first.
He has nothing of value. You feel terrible.
He pulls a pistol. You weren't expecting that.
He nods and shuffles off into the dusk.

the_radio.title: A Voice on the Radio
the_radio.description: Static. Then a woman's voice: '...this is Site 3, broadcasting on all frequencies. The cure is real. We have it. We are at — ' Static. The location is gone.

outcomes.text: You find Site 3. It's a strip mall. The woman is dead. She was alone for a long time.
You can't pin it down. The trail goes cold.
You find a survivor camp. Real people. They've never heard of Site 3.
You wonder, sometimes, what was real.

the_horde_passes.title: The Horde Passes
the_horde_passes.description: You hear them first — like rain, then like thunder, then like the world ending. A horde is moving past your shelter. If you stay perfectly still, they might not notice.

outcomes.text: Hours of held breath. They pass. You are alive.
Someone in your group sneezes. Or coughs. Or breathes too loud.
You take down a few. The rest turn. All of them. Turn.
You make it. Just barely. You leave most of your supplies.
You don't make it.

found_a_kid.title: A Kid Alone
found_a_kid.description: A child, maybe nine, sits in the doorway of a burnt-out house. She doesn't cry. She doesn't speak. She just looks at you.

outcomes.text: She follows. She doesn't speak for weeks. Then one morning she asks if you have any books.
She's not what you thought she was.
You leave a bandage and some food. You hate yourself. You keep walking.
You don't look at her. You will, every night, for a long time.

infected_member.title: Infection
infected_member.description: {party_member} pulls down their sleeve. The bite is fresh. They look at you and don't say anything.

options.text: Use antibiotics if you have them

outcomes.text: It works. The bite scars but doesn't turn. Lucky.
It doesn't work. They turn that night. You knew it might not work.
It works. They survive without an arm. They never quite forgive you.
Too late. They turn. You shoot them.
They die from blood loss. You're a survivor, not a surgeon.
It's quick. They thank you, almost. The others watch.

options.text: Hide the bite, hope for the best

outcomes.text: They turn at night. They take someone with them.
Somehow — somehow — they don't turn. They are immune. You don't tell anyone what happened.

hidden_stash.title: Hidden Stash
hidden_stash.description: Behind a false wall, taped under a desk, in the freezer — someone hid this for the apocalypse, and never came back for it.

outcomes.text: Cans, water, a few bandages. Enough for a few days.
Weapons cache. Whoever lived here was paranoid. Justifiably.
Pre-collapse cash and gold coins. Useless. You leave them.
A diary. The last entry is two years old. The cause was never the dead. It was always us. You read all of it.

false_alarm.title: False Alarm
false_alarm.description: Something moves in the bushes. You raise your weapon. Heart pounding. You wait.

outcomes.text: A raccoon. A truly enormous raccoon. It hisses at you and waddles off.
It's a zombie. Just one. You handle it.
It's a person. They were as scared as you. You both laugh, awkwardly. They walk on.

settlement_argument.title: An Argument
settlement_argument.description: Two of your people are screaming at each other in the courtyard. It's about food rations. It's not really about food rations.

outcomes.text: You pick. The other festers.
You broker peace. They both respect you a little more.
Neither listens. Now they're both mad at you.
They shut up. Resentfully.
They don't. One of them leaves in the night. With supplies.

found_a_book.title: A Book
found_a_book.description: A paperback in surprisingly good condition. The cover is gone. You read the first page.

outcomes.text: A romance novel. You read it cover to cover by candlelight.
A survival manual. Genuinely useful.
A children's book. You weep, quietly, and don't know why.
A book on the apocalypse. Written before. They got most of it wrong.

the_offer_to_join.title: Lost Soul
the_offer_to_join.description: Someone walks toward you with hands raised. They look exhausted. 'Please,' they say. 'I just want to not be alone.'

outcomes.text: They join you. You'll see who they are over time.
Their answers feel honest. Probably.
They nod, defeated, and turn around.
They scream curses and storm off. You watch your back for days.

swarm_warning.title: The Wind Smells Wrong
swarm_warning.description: There is a smell on the wind. Sweet and rotten. Birds have stopped singing in the direction it comes from. Something is moving — something big — and it is moving toward you.

outcomes.text: You ready everything you can. The horizon stays empty. For now.
Some part of you knew, and chose not to.

rain.title: Rain
rain.description: It rains for the first time in weeks. Real rain. You stand in it.

outcomes.text: You stand in it.
Practical. You collect rainwater in cans.

fortify_drill.title: Drills
fortify_drill.description: You spend the day running drills. Everyone moves through the routines twice. The walls don't get any sturdier — but everyone's ready to use them.

outcomes.text: Everyone is sharper. For a few days.
There's always tomorrow.

scout_returns.title: The Scout Returns
scout_returns.description: Your scout comes back at dawn, hands shaking. 'I saw it. Coming this way. We've got time — but only if we use it.'

options.text: Reinforce — the boards, the doors, everything

outcomes.text: By dusk you've doubled the defenses against whatever comes next.
It'll have to be enough.

argument_at_dinner.title: Argument at Dinner
argument_at_dinner.description: Voices rise at dinner. Someone accuses someone else of stealing — quietly. The room goes still.

outcomes.text: You sort it out. A misunderstanding. Mostly.
There's no proof. The accusation lingers.
Everyone resents you a little. The room is colder for days.
The whisper grows.

refugee_delegation.title: Refugees at the Gate
refugee_delegation.description: A small group stands at your gate. Five of them. One's a child. They have nothing.

outcomes.text: They join. Two pull their weight; one mostly cries; the child barely speaks.
Within a week, food runs short. Tension builds.

options.text: Give them food and send them on

outcomes.text: They thank you and walk into the dusk. You never see them again.
They leave silently. You watch them from a window.
In the night, you hear weeping. By morning the child is at the gate, alone.

tribute_demand.title: Tribute
tribute_demand.description: Three armed men at your gate. 'The Federal Remnant claims this district. We're collecting a contribution. Food, ammo, or labor. Pick.'

outcomes.text: They count it twice and leave.
They nod, respectful.
They leave, threatening. You don't see them for a week. Then you do.
They draw weapons. You barely survive the exchange.

internal_dispute_settled.title: A Vote
internal_dispute_settled.description: Half the settlement wants to ration food strictly. The other half says morale will collapse. They want you to decide.

outcomes.text: Reserves last longer. Faces get thinner. Conversations get shorter.
Two good meals. The dread lifts a little. So does the food supply.

options.text: Let them work it out themselves

outcomes.text: They reach a compromise. You earn no points but lose none.
Argument turns ugly. Someone walks out.

religious_convert.title: Conversion
religious_convert.description: {party_member} has been quiet for days. Tonight they tell you they've found faith — that the dead are sacred, and the Children of the Risen had it right. They're leaving in the morning.

outcomes.text: They embrace you at the gate. Then they walk into the dark.

options.text: Lock them in until it passes

outcomes.text: After three days they come back to themselves. They never speak of it again.
They escape in the night. Two others go with them.
By dawn they're crying and they stay.
They go anyway, harder this time.

generator_breakdown.title: Lights Out
generator_breakdown.description: The generator coughs and dies. The lights go out across the compound. Someone laughs nervously.

outcomes.text: By dawn it hums again. You barely slept.
It won't restart. You'll need to find a real mechanic.
You all sleep light. Nothing comes for you. This time.

wedding_at_the_end.title: A Wedding
wedding_at_the_end.description: Two of your survivors want to marry. Tonight. The bigger one is crying. The smaller one is laughing. They want everyone there.

outcomes.text: There are vows. There is bad wine. Everyone forgets, just for an hour.
They marry anyway, quietly, while you sit in your room.

broadcast_caller.title: Someone's Calling
broadcast_caller.description: Your scout reports a radio signal on a narrow band: '...if anyone hears this, we are at — coordinates following — we have a generator, food, walls, doctors. Please come.'

outcomes.text: They return with another faction's offer of alliance. Real one.
They don't return.
They find an empty bunker and a still-running tape.

options.text: Ignore it. The world is full of bait.

outcomes.text: The signal stops three days later.

patrol_report.title: Patrol Report
patrol_report.description: Your patrol returns at dusk. 'Movement south of the river. Big. Slow. Days away — but coming.'

outcomes.text: Done. If it comes, you'll have an answer.
Bags packed by the door. No one sleeps well.
Second patrol confirms. It's a horde. You have time.
Second patrol doesn't return.

quiet_day.title: A Quiet Day
quiet_day.description: Nothing happens today. Someone hums. The wind moves something on the roof. You play cards.

outcomes.text: You needed this.

strange_noises.title: Strange Noises
strange_noises.description: There's a scratching in the walls. Tap, tap, tap. Probably a rat. Probably.

outcomes.text: A rat. You name it Greg. Greg lives now.
A loose pipe. You tighten it.
You don't sleep great.

ammo_audit.title: Ammo Audit
ammo_audit.description: Someone's been counting the rounds. Some are missing. Or they were never there. It's hard to remember.

outcomes.text: Inventory was right. You miscounted yesterday.
Found a clip behind a shelf. You feel better.
Maybe later.

letter_in_the_drawer.title: A Letter in the Drawer
letter_in_the_drawer.description: Cleaning out a desk drawer, you find a letter. Written, never sent. To a son. From a father who lived here before. It's a good letter.

outcomes.text: You don't know him. You'll think about him for weeks.
Someone deserved more than this. You're not sure who.

the_smiling_face.title: The Smiling Face
the_smiling_face.description: There's a face painted on a wall along your path. White, with red lips, smiling too wide. Eyes scratched out. It wasn't there yesterday.

outcomes.text: You add three hours to the trip and don't regret it.
The paint won't cover it.
It covers easily. You feel slightly better.
It comes out in the photo. Different angle. Same smile.

the_photograph.title: A Photograph in a Wallet
the_photograph.description: A wallet on the road. Driver's license: Maria, 34. A photograph: Maria and a little boy at a beach. You're not on a beach. You're on a road.

options.text: Take the cash, leave the photo

outcomes.text: You take some cash. You leave the photo. You'll think about Maria.
It feels right. It changes nothing.

the_running_children.title: Children Running
the_running_children.description: You see them across a field. Three children, running silently. Not toward anything. Not from anything. Just running. They never get tired.

outcomes.text: They run until the sun sets. Then they're gone.
They stop running. They turn and look. You leave very quickly.
They don't hear. Or they don't acknowledge.

the_locked_basement.title: The Basement Door
the_locked_basement.description: The door is chained from this side. Chained shut by someone in this room. Whatever's down there, they wanted it to stay.

outcomes.text: It's empty. Long empty. A child's chair. A blanket. That's all.
Pre-collapse supply cache. Whoever lived here was prepared.
Something is still down there. You close the door. You leave.
Whoever they trusted, you can trust.

writing_on_the_wall.title: Writing on the Wall
writing_on_the_wall.description: Scrawled in something dark, across an entire wall: 'IT GETS IN THROUGH THE EYES.' Underneath, in smaller writing: 'don't look back. don't look back. don't look back.'

outcomes.text: Empty. Long empty. A pile of mirrors, all face-down.
You find a journal. The handwriting matches. You read the last page. You wish you hadn't.
You don't look back.

the_screaming_wind.title: Screaming Wind
the_screaming_wind.description: The wind picks up at dusk. It sounds like screaming. Not metaphorically. Specifically like a man screaming.

outcomes.text: A loose pipe in an old factory. You secure it. The screaming stops.
You find nothing. The screaming continues for hours.
You walk faster.

the_quiet_town.title: The Quiet Town
the_quiet_town.description: You enter a town. There are no zombies. There are no people. There are no birds. Doors hang open. Meals are on tables. Coffee still warm in some cups.

outcomes.text: You take what you can. Nothing follows you. You don't sleep well that night.
Something is wrong. You feel watched. You leave the loot.
The wind doesn't move in there. You're glad you didn't go in.

room_not_on_map.title: A Room That Wasn't On The Map
room_not_on_map.description: You map this building yesterday. Today there's a door where there was wall. The door is open. There is a room.

outcomes.text: Pre-collapse cache. Someone hid this very well.
The room is empty. When you turn to leave, the door is gone.
An old man sits in a chair. He looks at you. He says: 'You are early.'
You nail planks across it. You don't come back.

karaoke_machine.title: Karaoke Machine
karaoke_machine.description: In the back of a bar: a working karaoke machine. Battery half-full. The book is right there. The book has a duet section.

outcomes.text: You sing 'Total Eclipse of the Heart'. You feel briefly, gloriously alive.
Practical. You feel less alive.

the_cat.title: The Cat
the_cat.description: A cat. A regular orange cat. It looks at you. It blinks slowly. It does not seem concerned about the apocalypse.

outcomes.text: It tolerates your existence. You feel chosen.
It hisses and walks off, deeply offended.
It watches you the whole time. You nod. It does not nod back.

stuck_shopping_cart.title: The Stuck Shopping Cart
stuck_shopping_cart.description: A shopping cart is wedged into a storm drain. There are still some cans in it. The cart is going nowhere.

options.text: Fight the cart for the cans

outcomes.text: After thirty minutes, you win. The cart breaks. The cans are yours.
The cart wins. You sit on the curb. You laugh about it later.

polite_zombie.title: A Very Polite Zombie
polite_zombie.description: A zombie is shambling toward you. It stops at a crosswalk. It waits. The light is broken. The light has been broken for years. The zombie waits.

outcomes.text: After a few minutes, it shambles off in another direction. You salute. Nobody is who they were.
Quickly. Quietly. With apologies.

time_capsule.title: Time Capsule
time_capsule.description: A school time capsule, buried in 2019. To be opened in 2069. You open it. There's a Polaroid, a CD, a child's letter to 'the future people.' The letter is hopeful in the worst possible way.

options.text: Read the letter aloud to anyone within earshot

outcomes.text: There's laughing, and then there's crying.
Maybe a future will deserve it.

argument_about_books.title: Argument About Books
argument_about_books.description: Two of your survivors are loudly arguing about whether 'The Great Gatsby' is overrated. Voices raised. Nick Carraway has been called a coward.

outcomes.text: Justice is done. The defense sulks.
Justice is also done, differently.
Everyone goes back to surviving. Worse for it.

the_surrender.title: Surrender
the_surrender.description: A man on his knees, hands up. A raider. You saw him kill someone last week. He has a child with him.

outcomes.text: He becomes useful. Quiet. Useful.
Three nights later, he tries to leave with everything.
The child doesn't cry. You will, later.
The child watches. You did what you thought was right. You think.

the_prisoner.title: The Prisoner
the_prisoner.description: You find him tied up in a basement, badly beaten. He says cannibals had him. He says you have to let him go. He's also been bitten.

options.text: Untie him, give him a clean death

outcomes.text: He thanks you, almost. He doesn't look at the gun.
He screams as you walk away. You walk faster.
He's strong. He survives the turn — somehow. Joins you.
He turns within a day. You handle it.

the_hoarder.title: The Hoarder
the_hoarder.description: An old man in a house, surrounded by years of canned food. He has more than he could eat in a decade. He is alone. He won't share. He has a shotgun.

outcomes.text: He gives you some cans. You feel like you got the worse end.
He drops his gun. You take what you need. You'll remember his face.
He shoots first. You barely survive.
He nods. He locks the door. He won't last forever.

the_deserter.title: The Deserter
the_deserter.description: {party_member} packs their bag in the night and tries to leave. You catch them at the gate. They won't say where they're going. They're crying.

outcomes.text: They take some food and walk out. You hope they find something.
They stay. Quieter than before.
They stay one night and slip out the next.
They scream until dawn. Everyone is awake.

wounded_enemy.title: A Wounded Enemy
wounded_enemy.description: A raider, shot, bleeding out behind a car. He sees you. He whispers: 'Please.' He has a med kit on his belt.

outcomes.text: You take it. You walk away. The whisper stops.
He survives. Joins you. Quiet.
He dies anyway.
You did what he asked.

ration_cut.title: Cut Rations
ration_cut.description: There isn't enough food for everyone for the week. Someone has to take less.

outcomes.text: You lose weight. You earn respect.
They accept it. Quietly. You notice.
Fair. Worse, but fair.

abandoned_lab.title: Abandoned Lab
abandoned_lab.description: A hospital sub-basement, still cool. Refrigerators with broken locks. Vials marked with biohazard tape. A clipboard. Page 1: 'Subject responded to compound 7. Subject is asymptomatic at 96 hours.'

outcomes.text: Antibiotics, gauze, a few syringes.
Compound 7 is here. You don't know what it does. You take a vial.
Some answers shouldn't exist. You watch it burn.

broadcast_tower.title: The Broadcast Tower
broadcast_tower.description: A radio tower, still standing. A body at the base, headphones still on. The body is two years dead. The light on the panel still blinks.

outcomes.text: You broadcast. Hours pass. Then a faint reply: 'Who is this?' You're not alone.
You broadcast. Nothing answers. The light keeps blinking.
Decent kit. You move on.

patient_zero_rumor.title: A Rumor About Patient Zero
patient_zero_rumor.description: A trader at a campfire tells you a story. He says he met a man who claimed to be patient zero. A teacher, in Minnesota. Bitten by a tick. Survived. Never turned. Lives somewhere in the mountains.

outcomes.text: He has a map. He shouldn't have a map. He gives it to you.
He laughs. He says he made it all up. He doesn't sound sure.
Stories. Just stories.

federal_remnant_offer.title: The Remnant Recruits
federal_remnant_offer.description: Two men in fragmented uniforms approach. 'The Federal Remnant is rebuilding civil order. We're recruiting. Citizens get walls, food, rules. Some rules.' They wait.

outcomes.text: Your rep returns with supplies and a contract. You read the contract. You don't sign.
Your rep doesn't return.
They nod and walk on. They'll be back.
Fair prices, all things considered.

void_children_ritual.title: The Void Children
void_children_ritual.description: You see a clearing. Children in black robes — they look like children — surround a fire. They are very still. They are very quiet. They are looking at you.

outcomes.text: They speak as one: 'You are not yet ready.' They walk into the dark.
They attack as one.
You walk backward until they're out of sight.

pacifist_camp.title: A Pacifist Camp
pacifist_camp.description: A small camp by a stream. No walls. No fences. They greet you openly. 'We don't fight. We don't kill. We trade fairly. Some of us last a long time. Most don't.'

outcomes.text: Fair prices, real warmth.
An older woman comes along. She'll cook but never carry a weapon.
Nobody leaves the camp.
They smile gently. 'We know.'

salvage_crew_hire.title: Salvage Crew For Hire
salvage_crew_hire.description: Three engineers with too many tools. 'We salvage. We build. Pay us in scrap and we'll move your build along.'

outcomes.text: Two days off any active build. Whatever you've got.
The youngest joins. Calls themselves an engineer. Mostly correct.
They accept the payment, promise to return, vanish.
They move on. They wave.

rainstorm.title: Heavy Rain
rainstorm.description: It rains hard for two hours. You stand under an awning. You collect what you can.

outcomes.text: Clean water. Briefly clean clothes.

an_owl_at_dusk.title: An Owl at Dusk
an_owl_at_dusk.description: An owl on a branch. Awake. Aware. Indifferent. The world it knew is mostly gone. The world it knows now seems to suit it.

outcomes.text: You sit. It sits. The light fades. You both move on.

found_a_guitar.title: A Guitar
found_a_guitar.description: A guitar in a closet. Most strings intact. Mostly in tune.

outcomes.text: You remember most of one song.
It's heavy. You leave it after a day.
